title: Setup phase initializes the loop
statement: For all natural numbers $c,C,q$, every Boolean word $x$, and every $j\le q$, start in state $\mathrm{setup}$ with every work-head position equal to $j-1$, tape contents determined by $q$, and empty output. After $j+1$ steps the machine is in state $\mathrm{loop}(c)$, with every work head at position $0$ and output still empty.
